title.en: ‘Everybody is profiting’: Trump dismisses questions about over $1bn in crypto earnings – live

summary.en: Former US President Donald Trump has dismissed questions regarding over $1 billion in crypto earnings, stating that his funds are managed by a "blind account" and he does not communicate with those who run his money. This comes amidst key takeaways from his financial disclosures.

I’ve made a lot of money before I became president,” Trump said. “They’re big institutions, and they run it … I think it’s called a ‘blind account’, but they basically they take it, and I purposely I never speak to any of the people that run the money.” Continue reading...

It encourages us to consider our ultimate allegiances and the potential for wealth to distract from higher...

title.en: A storm, overpriced food and a sad ferris wheel: inside Trump’s dreadful state fair
title.zh: 一场暴风雨、天价食物和一座悲伤的摩天轮：特朗普糟糕的州博览会内幕

summary.en: The Great American State Fair, associated with Donald Trump, was reportedly a disappointing event marked by sparse attendance, extreme heat, and significantly overpriced food, including a $25 pretzel.

body.en: Attendance at the Great American State Fair is sparse and the heat is extreme, but at least you can pay $25 for a pretzel This was originally published in This Week in Trumpland. Sign up to receive it in your inbox every Wednesday I have been to some disappointing fairs in my time. There was one, in a small town in north-west England, where the main attraction was a little slide that you rode down on a burlap sack: except the guy who owned the slide had forgotten to bring the sacks, so me and my sister slid down on a T-shirt. Another time, at a village fete in a place called Longton, I won the main prize at the bingo. It was a whisky decanter with a bottle of whiskey. I was 11 years old, the decanter was broken and some bigger boys took the whiskey. More recently, I looked on as two farmers engaged in a shouting match over whose pumpkin was larger at a fair in Iowa. Continue reading...

Yahweh's wisdom suggests that genuine satisfaction comes from a spirit of generosity and care, rather than from material extravagance alone. A simple experience offered with integrity often brings more joy than...
reflection.zh: 这篇关于一场“糟糕”的博览会的报道，尽管其名称宏大且价格高昂，却提醒我们真正的价值并非总在于外在的排场或成本。雅伟的智慧表明，真正的满足源于慷慨和关怀的精神，而非仅仅物质上的奢华。一个以正直之心提供的简单体验，往往比一个缺乏实质内容的昂贵活动带来更多的喜乐。

title.en: Man guilty of attempted murder of three children in Dublin
title.zh: 都柏林男子企图谋杀三名儿童

summary.en: Riad Bouchaker denied attempting to murder three children and assaulting four other people on 23 November 2023.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A 52-year-old man has been found guilty of the attempted murder of three children and assaulting four other people in Dublin's Parnell Square in November 2023.

Riad Bouchaker, of no fixed address, was also found guilty of assault causing serious harm to crèche worker Leanne Flynn, and of assaulting two other children and a teenager.

The Central Criminal Court heard that a five-year-old girl has been left with a life-long brain injury after Bouchaker stabbed her in the heart.

The jury was sent out on Tuesday, they deliberated for around six hours and reached a verdict on Wednesday afternoon.

Judge Tony Hunt thanked the jury for their "hard work" and he said "having to listen by some of what you heard is very difficult".

He also thanked the jury for their verdicts and said they are "entirely in line with the evidence that you heard".

Sentencing has been set for 12 October and Bouchaker will be remanded in custody until then.

The most riot police in Irish state history were deployed to deal with the unrest.

Within hours of the attack, rioters destroyed 11 police vehicles, while 13 shops were badly damaged and more were looted during clashes with riot police.

Three buses and a tram were also destroyed and several police officers were injured during three hours of sustained violence.

Ireland's police chief at the time, Drew Harris blamed the rioting on a "lunatic, hooligan faction driven by a far-right ideology".
body.zh: 一名 52 岁男子于 2023 年 11 月在都柏林帕内尔广场企图谋杀三名儿童并袭击另外四人，被判有罪。 没有固定地址的 Riad Bouchaker 还被判犯有对托儿所工作人员 Leanne Flynn 造成严重伤害的袭击罪，以及袭击另外两名儿童和一名青少年的罪名。 中央刑事法院获悉，布查克刺伤了一名五岁女孩的心脏，导致她终身脑部受伤。 陪审团于周二出发，审议了大约六个小时，并于周三下午做出了裁决。 托尼·亨特法官感谢陪审团的“辛勤工作”，他说“必须倾听你所听到的一些内容是非常困难的”。 他还感谢陪审团的裁决，并表示“完全符合你听到的证据”。 宣判日期定于 10 月 12 日，布查克在此之前将被还押候审。 爱尔兰部署了历史上最多的防暴警察来应对骚乱。 袭击发生数小时内，暴徒摧毁了 11 辆警车，13 家商店严重受损，更多商店在与防暴警察的冲突中被抢劫。 在持续三个小时的暴力事件中，三辆公共汽车和一辆有轨电车被毁，几名警察受伤。 时任爱尔兰警察局长德鲁·哈里斯将骚乱归咎于“极右意识形态驱动的疯狂流氓派系”。

title.en: Syria's president names final 70 lawmakers to new post-Assad parliament
title.zh: 叙利亚总统任命最后70名议员加入阿萨德后新议会

summary.en: Fifteen women are appointed, after only six female candidates were selected by regional electoral colleges last October.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Syria's Interim President Ahmed al-Sharaa has appointed the final 70 members of the country's new parliament, paving the way for it to hold its first session next week.

Fifteen of the new lawmakers are women and 13 were imprisoned during the rule of Bashar al-Assad, who was overthrown in 2024. It is not clear how many are members of religious and ethnic minorities.

Last October, regional electoral colleges selected two-thirds of the 210-seat People's Assembly , which will be responsible for legislation during the transitional period.

After only six seats were won by women and 10 by minority candidates, electoral officials said Sharaa would use his appointments to address the imbalance.

Mohammed Taha al-Ahmed, chairman of the Higher Committee for the Syrian People's Assembly Elections, said the president's selections combined "the voice of sacrifice and the voice of experience" within the People's Assembly, represented the diverse segments of Syrian society, and reinforced national unity.

They included "relatives of martyrs and survivors of detention and chemical attacks" during the 13-year civil war, as well as academics, experts, professionals, community leaders and national figures "known for their experience, integrity and public service", he added.

Ahmed also said the new appointees hailed from across all 14 provinces, including two from Suweida, which has a predominantly Druze population.

The electoral college polls have not yet been held in Suweida because the southern province has remained outside state control since 1,700 people were killed in sectarian fighting between government forces, Sunni Bedouin tribes and Druze militias last July.

"When conditions become suitable to hold elections in this good and blessed governorate, God willing, we will conduct the elections there," Ahmed said.

The polls were also delayed by seven months in parts of the northern provinces of Raqqa and Hassakeh, which government forces captured from the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) militia alliance at the start of this year.

More than 20 Kurdish parties rejected the lawmakers who were selected by electoral colleges in May, saying the process revealed "an approach of exclusion and marginalisation".

Fourteen Syrian civil society groups also criticised the electoral system last year, describing it as "plagued by deep structural flaws".

They said the president's direct and indirect influence over the membership of the Higher Committee and the electoral colleges rendered the elections symbolic.

And they expressed concern that the president's power to appoint one third of the members of parliament and name a replacement for anyone who lost their seat would allow him to dominate an institution meant to be independent and reflective of popular...
body.zh: 叙利亚临时总统艾哈迈德·沙拉已经任命了该国新议会的最后 70 名成员，为下周举行第一次会议铺平了道路。 新立法者中有 15 名是女性，其中 13 名在巴沙尔·阿萨德 (Bashar al-Assad) 统治期间被监禁，巴沙尔·阿萨德于 2024 年被推翻。目前尚不清楚有多少人是宗教少数群体和少数民族成员。 去年10月，地区选举团选出了210个席位的人民议会中的三分之二，该议会将负责过渡时期的立法。 在女性候选人仅赢得 6 个席位、少数族裔候选人赢得 10 个席位后，选举官员表示，沙拉将利用他的任命来解决这种不平衡问题。 叙利亚人民议会选举高级委员会主席穆罕默德·塔哈·艾哈迈德表示，总统的选举结合了人民议会内“牺牲的声音和经验的声音”，代表了叙利亚社会的不同阶层，并加强了民族团结。 他补充说，他们包括13年内战期间“烈士的亲属和拘留和化学袭击的幸存者”，以及“以经验、诚信和公共服务而闻名”的学者、专家、专业人士、社区领袖和国家人物。 艾哈迈德还表示，新任命的人员来自所有 14 个省，其中两人来自德鲁兹人口占主导地位的苏韦达。 选举团投票尚未在苏韦达举行，因为自去年 7 月政府军、逊尼派贝都因部落和德鲁兹民兵之间的教派战斗造成 1,700 人死亡以来，该南部省份一直处于国家控制之外。 艾哈迈德说：“当条件变得适合在这个美好而幸福的省份举行选举时，如果上帝愿意，我们将在那里举行选举。” 北部省份拉卡和哈塞克部分地区的投票也推迟了七个月，政府军今年年初从库尔德人领导的叙利亚民主力量（SDF）民兵联盟手中夺取了这两个省份。 20多个库尔德政党拒绝了5月份选举团选出的议员，称这一过程暴露了“一种排斥和边缘化的做法”。 去年，14个叙利亚民间社会团体也批评了选举制度，称其“深受深刻的结构性缺陷困扰”。 他们表示，总统对高级委员会和选举团成员的直接和间接影响使这次选举具有象征意义。 他们表示担心，总统有权任命三分之一的议员，并任命一名失去席位的人的替代者，这将使他能够主宰一个本应独立并反映民意的机构……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Fire kills five at Antwerp apartment block
title.zh: 安特卫普公寓楼火灾造成多人死伤

summary.en: A fire broke out in a 10-storey apartment building in Antwerp, Belgium, resulting in several deaths and injuries. The incident occurred in the city's Linkeroever district.
summary.zh: 比利时安特卫普市林克罗弗区一栋10层公寓楼发生火灾，造成多人死伤。

body.en:
Five people have died and several others have been injured in a fire that broke out in a 10-storey block of flats in Antwerp, Belgian police say.

Thick smoke was seen billowing from the eighth floor of the building in the Linkeroever district, after the fire broke out just before 10:00 (08:00 GMT) on Wednesday.

Dramatic video showed a man clambering from his balcony through a neighbour's window to escape the black smoke.

Police say more than 200 people live in the block and the fire department evacuated 80 flats in the building.

"It has claimed a heavy toll here at Linkeroever," police spokeswoman Kim Bastiaens told Belgian public TV, adding that a number of people had suffered from serious and minor injuries.

Police had earlier spoken of six deaths but later revised the number down to five and during the afternoon the Antwerp fire service said the fire had been put out.

Philippe, King of the Belgians, later travelled to Linkeroever to meet some of the residents evacuated to a residential care centre and visit the scene of the fire.

Resident Geert Dewulf told VRT how thick smoke had stopped him getting out of his flat: "We barricaded ourselves into our flat and waited on the balcony. The fire brigade came to rescue us from the balcony 10 minutes or so later with their ladder."

Firefighters said they were going from flat to flat to search for possible victims, explaining that the smoke had spread quickly through the building, making it harder to evacuate people.

Another man said his parents-in-law, one of them ex-mayor of Antwerp Bob Cools, had been successfully evacuated from the building and taken to hospital.

"We tried our utmost to save the cat but unfortunately in the end we were unable to," he said.

Antwerp fire brigade spokeswoman Marie de Clercq said it was a complex fire and the poor visibility and thick smoke in the building had made it difficult to put out.

Prime Minister Bart De Wever said his thoughts were with the victims and the evacuated residents of the "terrible fire" in Linkeroever.

The Flemish parliament began its session on Wednesday afternoon with a minute's silence for the victims of the fire.
body.zh: 比利时警方称，安特卫普一栋 10 层公寓楼发生火灾，造成多人死亡、多人受伤。 周三 10:00（格林威治标准时间 08:00）前发生火灾后，Linkeroever 区大楼的八楼冒出滚滚浓烟。 戏剧性的视频显示，一名男子从邻居的窗户爬出阳台，以躲避黑烟。 居民Geert Dewulf告诉比利时公共电视台，浓烟阻止他走出公寓：“我们把自己关在公寓里，在阳台上等待。大约10分钟后，消防队用梯子从阳台上救了我们。” 消防队员表示，他们正在从一个公寓到另一个公寓寻找可能的受害者，并解释说烟雾已迅速在建筑物中蔓延，使得疏散人员变得更加困难。 另一名男子表示，他的岳父母，其中一位是安特卫普前市长鲍勃·库尔斯，已成功从大楼撤离并被送往医院。 “我们尽了最大努力去救这只猫，但不幸的是最终我们没能成功，”他说。 警方表示，现在确定起火原因还为时过早，但目击者告诉《De Standaard》报纸，屋顶正在施工。

reflection.en: In the wake of such a sudden and devastating fire, our hearts go out to all affected by this tragedy. When life feels fragile and trouble strikes unexpectedly, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in times of distress. May those grieving find comfort, and may the injured experience healing and support from their...
reflection.zh: 面对这场突如其来的毁灭性火灾，我们的心与所有受害者同在。当生命感到脆弱，意外的灾难降临时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。愿逝者家属得安慰，伤者得医治，并从社区获得支持。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Controversial bishops ordained as Pope warns of 'schism' in Catholic Church
title.zh: 教皇警告天主教会“分裂”，任命备受争议的主教

summary.en: Thousands of worshippers attended a ceremony in the Swiss Alps as part of the breakaway Society of Saint Pius X.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及在压力下的忠信与属灵勇气。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Thousands of people have gathered in a tiny village in Switzerland to witness the ordination of four new Catholic bishops, in defiance of an appeal by Pope Leo XIV.

The four, one from the United States, one from Switzerland, and two from France, are members of the controversial Society of Saint Pius X (SSPX), also sometimes known as Lefebrvistes after SSPX's founder Marcel Lefebvre.

The Society rejects key modernising reforms introduced by the Vatican in the 1960s and 1970s, including permission to hold Mass in languages spoken by the congregation, rather than only in Latin.

Pope Leo made a last minute appeal to SSPX leaders earlier this week not to proceed with the ordination, describing it as a "schismatic act", which could "tear the seamless garment of Christ".

But on Wednesday morning, under cool grey Alpine skies, the society defied the Pope – regarded by millions of Catholics as God's representative on Earth – and proceeded with the ordination.

At least 15,000 people gathered in Écône to watch hundreds of robed priests - carrying candles and crosses, and dispensing incense - progress through the village into a pasture where a large tent had been set up.

There, the four candidates for bishop prostrated themselves before an altar, their heads buried in red velvet pillows. Ceremonial organ music played, the ordination vows were taken, of course, in Latin.

The last time the Society ordained new bishops, in 1988, they were immediately excommunicated.

Although Pope Benedict XVI repealed the excommunication in 2009 in an unsuccessful attempt to heal the rift, Pope Leo is also expected to exclude the new bishops from the Catholic Church.

To some, the Vatican's objections to SSPX may seem exaggerated; after all, many Churches have separate branches, some more conservative than others. But ordaining bishops without the Pope's consent is regarded as a serious violation of the unity of the Church.

The Society, founded by controversial French archbishop Marcel Lefebre in 1970, has always wanted to preserve a kind of medieval mystique in which priests, bishops, cardinals, and the Mass itself are seen as somehow closer to God, and therefore separate from ordinary people.

SSPX has consistently defied the Vatican over multiple policies designed to make the Church more accessible and egalitarian, including establishing ties with other religions, recognising the right to religious freedom, and participating in debates over big social and political questions.

It even objected to the Vatican's decision to have priests face the congregation when holding Mass, preferring the medieval practice of facing the altar, with their backs to the congregants.

SSPX's Superior General, Davide Pagliarani, denied trying to sustain the rift, telling the congregation...
body.zh: 数千人不顾教皇利奥十四世的呼吁，聚集在瑞士的一个小村庄，见证四位新天主教主教的任命。 这四人，一名来自美国，一名来自瑞士，两名来自法国，是备受争议的圣庇护十世协会 (SSPX) 的成员，该协会有时也被称为 Lefebrvistes，以 SSPX 创始人马塞尔·列斐伏尔 (Marcel Lefebvre) 的名字命名。 该协会拒绝梵蒂冈在 20 世纪 60 年代和 1970 年代推行的关键现代化改革，包括允许以会众使用的语言（而不仅仅是拉丁语）举行弥撒。 教皇利奥本周早些时候在最后一刻呼吁 SSPX 领导人不要继续进行祝圣仪式，称其为“分裂行为”，可能“撕裂基督的无缝外衣”。 但周三早上，在寒冷的灰色阿尔卑斯山天空下，该协会藐视教皇——被数百万天主教徒视为上帝在地球上的代表——并继续进行祝圣仪式。 至少 15,000 人聚集在埃科内，观看数百名身穿长袍的牧师携带蜡烛和十字架并散发香，穿过村庄进入一个已经搭建了大帐篷的牧场。 在那里，四位主教候选人跪在祭坛前，头埋在红色天鹅绒枕头里。仪式上演奏了管风琴音乐，任命誓言当然是用拉丁语进行的。 上一次该协会任命新主教是在1988年，他们立即被逐出教会。 尽管教皇本笃十六世在2009年废除了绝罚，试图弥合裂痕，但没有成功，但预计教皇利奥也将把新主教排除在天主教会之外。 对某些人来说，梵蒂冈对 SSPX 的反对似乎有些夸大。毕竟，许多教会都有独立的分支机构，其中一些教会比其他教会更保守。但未经教宗同意任命主教被视为严重违反教会的团结。 该协会由备受争议的法国大主教马塞尔·勒费布尔 (Marcel Lefebre) 于 1970 年创立，一直希望保留一种中世纪的神秘感，在这种神秘感中，神父、主教、红衣主教和弥撒本身在某种程度上被视为更接近上帝，因此与普通人分开。 SSPX 一直在多项旨在让教会更容易接近和平等的政策上反抗梵蒂冈，包括与其他宗教建立联系、承认宗教自由权以及参与重大社会和政治问题的辩论。 它甚至反对梵蒂冈让神父在举行弥撒时面向会众的决定，更喜欢中世纪的做法，面向祭坛，背对会众。 SSPX 的高级将军戴维德·帕利亚拉尼 (Davide Pagliarani) 否认试图维持裂痕，并告诉会众……

reflection.en: This story draws attention to faithfulness under pressure and spiritual courage. Hebrews 10:23 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steadfast faith and prayerful witness, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到在压力下的忠信与属灵勇气。Hebrews 10:23提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以坚定的信心与祷告见证来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: Trump made more than $1bn from crypto in first year back in office
title.zh: 特朗普卸任第一年从加密货币中赚取逾10亿美元

summary.en: The former president reportedly earned over $1 billion from various commercial ventures, including cryptocurrency, real estate, and branded merchandise, during his first year out of office.
summary.zh: 据报道，这位前总统在卸任后的第一年里，通过加密货币、房地产和品牌商品等多种商业活动，收入超过10亿美元。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump made more than $1.4bn (£1.05bn) last year from business dealings in cryptocurrency, according to his mandatory financial report.

In a 927-page disclosure, he reported $635m in royalties from an entity called Celebration Coins, thought to be behind the $TRUMP meme coin which has plunged in value since he launched it days before taking office.

He also reported over $500m in income from World Liberty Financial, a cryptocurrency firm founded by his own sons and the children of his special envoy, Steve Witkoff.

The White House denied he was profiting from the presidency. Trump said "everybody" was profiting from rising stock markets, and he doesn't get involved with his personal finances.

The crypto-related earnings from his latest financial disclosure total $1,430,390,415.

Meanwhile, Trump's total income last year was least $2.2bn, far more than his disclosed income for 2024, when he showed over $600m of income.

The White House, which has repeatedly emphasised that Trump has placed his businesses in a trust managed by his sons, again denied any conflict of interest.

White House deputy press secretary Anna Kelly said the president had proudly made the US "the crypto capital of the world".

"Neither the President nor his family has ever engaged - or will ever engage - in conflicts of interest," she said in a statement.

She added: "All actions by President Trump and his administration are taken in the best interest of the American people – and any so-called 'reporters' pushing otherwise are recycling the same, tired, false narrative that Democrats and the legacy media have been pushing for a decade."

The president himself has also highlighted that he is not subject to federal conflict of interest laws.

Trump told reporters on Wednesday: "You know why I'm profiting, because the stock market's going up, everybody's profiting."

He said: "I don't get involved in my personal [finances], we have funds that run my money.

"I've made a lot of money before I became president, and they invest my money, and I don't talk to them."

Trump once criticised cryptocurrency, famously calling Bitcoin a "scam" in 2021 and a "disaster waiting to happen".

But, during his presidential campaign three years later, Trump said he wanted to make the US the "crypto capital of the planet". One of his first actions when he returned to the White House last year was an executive order to "support the responsible growth" of the crypto industry.

Richard Painter, the former chief White House ethics lawyer under George W Bush, told the BBC it was "extraordinary", that Trump had made $1bn from crypto.

Will Walker-Arnott, director of private clients at Raymond James Wealth Management, said: "His approach, I suppose, is in contrast to previous presidents...
body.zh: 根据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 2025 年的强制性财务报告，去年他从加密货币业务交易中赚取了超过 10 亿美元（7.5 亿英镑）。 在一份长达 927 页的披露文件中，他报告了一枚特朗普模因币的版税为 6.35 亿美元，自从他上任前三天推出该币以来，该币的价值已经暴跌。 他还报告了世界自由金融公司 (World Liberty Financial) 的收入超过 5 亿美元，这是一家由他自己的儿子和他的特使史蒂夫·威特科夫 (Steve Witkoff) 的孩子创立的加密货币公司。 他从房地产和特朗普主题物品中赚取了数百万美元。但白宫否认他从总统职位中获利。 特朗普最新披露的 2024 年财务报告显示的收入远远超过之前披露的超过 6 亿美元的收入。 但白宫一再强调特朗普已将其业务交由其儿子管理的信托基金管理，再次否认存在任何利益冲突。 白宫副新闻秘书安娜·凯利表示，总统自豪地使美国成为“世界加密货币之都”。 她在一份声明中说：“总统和他的家人都没有、也不会参与利益冲突。” 她补充道：“特朗普总统及其政府的所有行动都是为了美国人民的最大利益而采取的，而任何所谓的‘记者’若提出不同的要求，都是在重复民主党和传统媒体十年来一直在推动的相同、陈旧、虚假的叙述。” 特朗普曾批评加密货币，著名地称比特币是“骗局”和“即将发生的灾难”。 但周二的披露显示，他的加密货币收入超过了他的房地产业务收入，而正是房地产业务让他一举成名。 他从海湖庄园俱乐部赚取了约 7700 万美元，从佛罗里达州多拉尔高尔夫俱乐部赚取了 1.22 亿美元。 他还从新泽西州贝德明斯特、佛罗里达州朱庇特和苏格兰坦伯利的高尔夫球俱乐部各赚取了超过 3000 万美元。 根据财务披露，特朗普还从其他商业投资中赚取了数百万美元。 其中包括特朗普品牌手表的 470 万美元特许权使用费，以及特朗普品牌的圣经、运动鞋、香水和吉他。 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普也在披露中列出了她 2025 年的收入。她从去年发行的关于她的纪录片相关的“许可协议”中赚取了 1070 万美元。 她还列出了销售 NFT 的另外 600 万美元收入，这些 NFT 是在线销售的数字图像。 总统还列出了各种法律诉讼的数百万美元和解金。 其中包括针对 ABC 的诉讼获得的 1600 万美元、来自 CBS Broadcasting 和 CBS Interactive 的 1600 万美元、来自 Meta 的 2450 万美元、来自 YouTube 的 2200 万美元以及来自 X 的 800 万美元。 但白宫表示，大部分资金都捐给了特朗普未来的总统图书馆或非营利组织……

reflection.en: This news highlights the constant tension between pursuing worldly wealth and serving higher callings. For those in public life, the accumulation of vast personal fortunes can raise questions about ultimate loyalties and priorities. Yahweh reminds us that our hearts cannot be fully devoted to both God and material gain.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了追求世俗财富与服事更高呼召之间持续存在的张力。对于那些身居公职的人来说，积累巨额个人财富可能会引发对其最终忠诚和优先事项的质疑。雅伟提醒我们，我们的心不能同时完全忠于雅伟和物质利益。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: How the cocoa price crash is crushing West African farmers
title.zh: 可可价格暴跌如何压垮西非农民

summary.en: Cocoa prices reached a peak in 2024 before plummeting by nearly 75%, dealing a financial blow to millions of farmers in Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire. Will the crisis mark a turning point for the sector?
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Cocoa prices reached a peak in 2024 before plummeting by nearly 75%, dealing a financial blow to millions of farmers in Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire. Will the crisis mark a turning point for the sector?

It's a tough choice. "If I send my children to school and can't bring in part of the harvest, we won't have enough money for food. Or do I take them out of school so  we can harvest more cocoa and have three meals a day?" a cocoa farmer from Cote d'Ivoire  told DW.

Cocoa prices have recently plunged after the  historic surge  to nearly $13,000 (€11,000) per metric ton in 2024. In early April 2026, the world market price temporarily fell to $3,000, a decline of more than 75% in just over a year.

The low prices have had a massive impact on the approximately 2.5 million smallholder farmers who  grow cocoa in West Africa.

Farmers like Firmin Coulibaly from Cote d'Ivoire are forced to sell their cocoa beans at very low prices. "Producers are dying in poverty even though they have crops. They have no money for medicine or food," he told DW.

In Ghana , too, many farmers are suffering from delayed payments because middlemen are no longer buying their cocoa. "Because of the delayed payment, I don't have money to pay the workers who harvest the crop," said farmer Emmanuel Nojor. "That's why the harvest has gone bad."

He added that the middlemen have been withholding his payments for around five months.

Whether it's for medicine , pesticides, or paying day laborers, there's a shortage of everything. "I would use part of the money for my child's school fees, which I haven't been able to pay so far. He's sitting at home and wasn't able to take the exams," said Nojor.

According to the  International Cocoa Organization (ICCO) , the high prices in 2024 were initially driven by poor harvests in West Africa, resulting in a supply shortage.

For several months, Ukrainian forces have been targeting energy infrastructure in Russian regions and on the illegally annexed Crimean Peninsula . Russian supply routes in the occupied territories, as well as key oil refineries inside Russia itself, have come under attack.

In June alone, refineries in Moscow, Nizhnekamsk, Tyumen and Volgograd were struck. In May, a total of 16 refineries were attacked. As a result, gasoline production has fallen by 25%, Reuters reported, citing its own sources. Russia is currently producing only 85,000 metric tons of gasoline per day, while summer demand stands at 110,000 metric tons per day.

"This summer, Russia appears to be heading toward what could be the worst fuel crisis in its history," experts at the US think tank Energy Intelligence said.

On June 28, Russian President Vladimir Putin publicly acknowledged "certain fuel shortages" for the first time.

"There is some damage," he said in an interview on Russian state television, adding that all the damaged facilities are being repaired fairly quickly, and the problems are not critical.

"Putin was forced to openly admit that the problem exists," Zavadskaya, a political scientist at the Finnish Institute of International Affairs, told DW. "Most importantly, he identified the cause of the problem — Ukrainian drone attacks."

According to estimates by the Russian business outlet RBC, 40 Russian regions have already introduced restrictions on fuel sales. According to the independent Russian news outlet Vyorstka, which analyzed official information and eyewitness reports, as many as 78 regions may be affected. In many cities, long lines have formed at gas stations.

Christina Harward, an expert at the Institute for the Study of War (ISW) in Washington, DC, said Ukraine had already attempted to strike Russian refineries in 2025.

"What's different this year is that Ukraine has clearly scaled up the quantity of their drones and the quality of their drones. They've improved the range of their drones and, for the past couple of months, they've also been undertaking an effort to identify and destroy Russian air defense systems," Harward said.

At the same time, Ukrainian forces are trying to disrupt the Russian military's supply routes near the front line. title.en: China's tech rise reshapes the global space race

summary.en: China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

body.en:
China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

Lai Kai-ying, the first female Chinese civilian to reach outer space, is currently on board China's crewed Tiangong space station , where she orbits the Earth 16 times a day, alongside two other Chinese astronauts.

Tiangong is a unique microgravity laboratory for scientific experiments, designed to provide new insights into humanity's future.

Today, aviation and spaceflight are once again shaped by ideological rivalry, echoing the mid-20th-century space race between the United States and the Soviet Union. In the 21st century, however, Washington's primary competitor is no longer Moscow, but Beijing.

US space agency NASA intends to retire its landmark research outpost, the International Space Station (ISS), by 2032. When that happens, China will be the only country operating a permanently crewed orbital station.

Space travel is just one of many fields worldwide in which China now holds a technological lead, according to Nature.

The journal's latest index of research leaders , which reveals the leading institutions and countries/territories, puts China in first place — well ahead of the United States and Germany . 

Nine of the Top 10 research institutions were from China, with the US' Harvard ranking third. Germany's Max Planck Society (MPG), Germany's preeminent research organization, ranked in 13th place.

"It is now almost irrelevant which global rankings you consult. Universities and research institutions in China lead in many fields," observed Christina Beck, spokesperson for theMPG.

The Nature Index also shows that Chinese research institutions are the clear leaders in biology, chemistry and physics, as well as in other applied sciences. Only in health sciences and the social sciences have they been surpassed by US institutions.

China's rise has taken place steadily over the past two decades, said Richard Heidler, director of information management at the German Research Foundation (DFG), Germany's largest research funding organization.

"While in the early 2000s it was primarily the volume of publications that increased significantly, bibliometric analyses over the past decade have also shown growing gains in impact-related indicators, such as the share and number of highly cited publications," Heidler said.

In other words, China is not only publishing more, but is becoming increasingly better and more visible, which the MPG's Beck said is based on a long-term development process.

title.en: Japan's new joint custody law reshapes divorce debate
title.zh: 日本新共同监护法重塑离婚争论

summary.en: As Japan introduces joint custody, some couples find it easier to part ways. But the reform sparks debate over whether children's interests are truly central in a system still led by parents.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As Japan introduces joint custody, some couples find it easier to part ways. But the reform sparks debate over whether children's interests are truly central in a system still led by parents.

"After five years of separation, the law change finally gave us a push for a divorce," Mariya Yamada, a 46-year-old Japanese television personality and actress, told DW in late June, showing her completed divorce certificate with a fresh smile.

"I will submit this paper next week — with the custody box checked for both my husband and myself — and it's all done," she said.

Soon after, the mother of a 13-year-old son announced the completion of her divorce from her actor husband, following Japan's introduction of joint custody for divorced parents in April.

The popular couple's timely divorce  drew widespread attention in Japanese media, including major television networks and sports newspapers.

"My husband kept saying that he didn't want to lose custody of our son," Yamada said, "but now he can finally accept the divorce."

Prior to the new legislation, Japan was the only G7 country that granted custody to only one parent after divorce.

Under the revised Civil Code, parents with joint custody are required to discuss decisions that could have a significant impact on their child's life, such as where the child lives and which school they attend.

When parents cannot agree on their own, the family court determines custody based on the child's best interests.

The law also allows parents who divorced before the reform came into effect to apply to the court to convert an existing sole custody arrangement into joint custody.

In the case of  domestic violence or abuse , the court will grant sole custody to one parent.

In Japan, where around 90% of divorces are settled by mutual agreement without court intervention and only sole custody had been recognized before April, the interests of children after their parents' divorce have often taken a back seat.

A 26-year-old woman working in Tokyo, whose parents divorced when she and her younger sister were in elementary school, reflected that she struggled to understand when her father was granted sole custody due to adult priorities, such as financial stability, even though both kids "felt much more attached to mother."

"I always wished I could have lived with my mother," she told DW. "Whenever I had to fill out official documents, I could only write father's name as my parent."

She felt a gap between the legal arrangement and everyday life, as her mother continued to take care of them after the divorce, including frequent dinners at her mother's house. She vividly remembers her younger sister crying when she had to part from their mother.

summary.zh: 新闻报道称，2025年一项政治决定导致全球最大的国际人道主义援助机构被解散。一年后，其影响被描述为毁灭性的，对像拉迪卡这样失去摆脱早婚机会的个人造成了冲击。

body.en:

Radhika Yadav harbours a fear no child should: that she'll be forced to marry before she turns 18.

In Nepal, where the 13-year-old lives, it's one shared by millions. The country is home to five million child brides, and Yadav knows she could soon become one of them.

UDAAN, an education program run by CARE International for girls aged 10 to 14 who have never attended school or dropped out early, gave her a glimmer of hope. The intensive 11-month curriculum is designed to transition girls into formal education and help open doors to them that poverty and tradition had slammed shut.

Then, in 2025, funding for the program — CARE says the name means "flight" or "flying high" — was cut and the school closed overnight. Yadav and 307 other girls were sent home; their daily studies replaced with daily chores.

"Before, I was learning new things every day. I was excited about going to school again," Radhika told CARE International.

Yadav's mother, Sundar Kala, watched her daughter transform at UDAAN — learning to read, write, count and speak up for herself. After the program stopped, she watched that confidence drain away.

For girls in disadvantaged communities in Nepal, the risks multiply. School attendance means sacrificing immediate income, as girls are often required to work to earn money for their families. So, when resources are scarce, sons take priority.

Yet girls who don't go to school are far more vulnerable to early marriage, gender-based violence and trafficking, including to India and the Gulf states, where they may be forced into domestic servitude or exploitative labour.

The funding cuts at UDAAN impacted more than 300 girls, but this is a global problem.

Approximately 12 million girls are married before the age of 18 each year, according to the Institute of Global Politics, which warns that "significant cuts in foreign assistance" are slowing or even reversing progress.

UNICEF USA warns that steep cuts to global education funding could push six million more children out of school in the coming year.

Yadav's story is part of a global crisis that began on 20 January 2025 — United States President Donald Trump's first day back in office.

Trump ordered a near-total freeze on US foreign aid, and on 1 July, the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) was shuttered. Some 83 per cent of its programs were cancelled, and its remaining functions were absorbed into the State Department.

This story serves as a sober reminder of our collective responsibility...

title.en: Donald Trump's bumper day of wins, losses, and growing power
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在一天之内经历胜败参半，权力日益增长

summary.en: Over a single day, the US Supreme Court issued significant rulings concerning former President Donald Trump's key policies, resulting in a mix of legal victories and defeats for his agenda.
summary.zh: 在一天之内，美国最高法院就前总统唐纳德·特朗普的一些标志性政策做出了重大裁决，使其议程在法律上既有胜利也有挫折。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has faced mixed Supreme Court ruling streak, with the country's highest judicial chamber delivering both victories and defeats for several of his centrepiece policies.

The Supreme Court is where many of Trump's executive orders, like the sweeping and broad-ranging policy declarations signed in the first months of his presidency , are scrutinised by judges appointed by the state.

On Tuesday, the final sitting day for the term, the court's nine government-appointed judges passed long-awaited decisions on some of Trump's most controversial executive orders, laws and edicts.

They range from immigration to transgender participation in sport, to one of Trump's most scandalous firings.

Trump suffered a massive blow to the anti-immigration initiatives at the heart of his second presidency after the Supreme Court rejected a bid to restrict birthright citizenship.

The move was part of a raft of executive orders signed on the first day of his second stint at the White House, announcing that children born to parents in the United States who were there illegally or on temporary visas would not automatically become US citizens.

On Tuesday, the court ruled 6-3 to maintain the right to American citizenship for nearly everyone born on US soil — even when their parents are not US citizens.

"Children born in the United States to parents unlawfully or temporarily present are 'subject to the jurisdiction' of the United States and are citizens at birth under the Fourteenth Amendment's Citizenship Clause," chief justice John Roberts wrote in the court's opinion.

SBS News previously reported that Trump's move drew parallels with reforms introduced in 1986 under the Hawke government. In Australia, children of temporary residents qualify for citizenship after living in the country for the first 10 years of their lives.

Following the ruling, the US Justice Department released a memo directing prosecutors to investigate "birth tourism" and promising to "zealously protect the sanctity of United States citizenship".

The executive order was part of a broader campaign to limit immigration, with widespread detention and deportations sparking protest and unrest across the country .

The Supreme Court thwarted Trump's bid to fire one of the governors of the Federal Reserve — the US central bank.

Lisa Cook was the first black woman to sit on the Federal Reserve Board of Governors. The former economics professor was appointed to the board by the Biden administration in 2022.

title.en: 'She has such an aura': The 20-year-old Aussie who just beat Serena Williams at Wimbledon
title.zh: “她有这样的光环”：刚刚在温网击败塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的 20 岁澳大利亚人

summary.en: Rising Australian tennis star Maya Joint produced the best match of her career to prevail over the tennis legend.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Serena Williams' Wimbledon comeback at 44 has been sensationally dynamited on Centre Court by Australian Maya Joint, who delivered a stunning performance to out-battle and finally subdue the hugely impressive returning legend.

In the match of her life, the 20-year-old Queenslander produced the best display of her career to prevail 6-3 6-7 (6-8) 6-3, withstanding everything that the player who may be the game's greatest ever could throw at her.

Joint overcame the disappointment of missing out on a match point when on the verge of a straight-sets win, then battled back after Williams had roared into a third-set lead to seal a monumental triumph in a two-hour 22-minute classic.

The emotional victory left Joint, who grew up in the US state of Michigan where Williams was also born, almost dumbfounded.

"I didn't get much sleep last night, I was up 'til 2 am just thinking about it. She has such an aura, she's such a legend," she told the crowd.

"I've been dreaming about this moment since I was a little kid, so this is pretty crazy."

Williams left her old Centre Court domain as she'd entered it, to thunderous cheers from the crowd, and she offered a wave to all sides, which had a real valedictory feel.

For though she may have been more than half-a-step slower and inevitably rusty after nearly four years away from singles action, she was still astonishingly impressive, three months before her 45th birthday against one of the sport's rising stars.

Yet her US-born opponent stayed strong, even as seemingly all the crowd were baying for a sentimental Serena triumph under the roof, perhaps proving how much the game has moved on in the 23-time slam champion's absence.

Joint had lost 13 of her previous 14 matches stretching back to January and had dropped to No.87 to be only the Australian No.4, but she was still a cut above the old champion, who threw in 190km/h-plus serves and occasional rocket groundstrokes, only to have them, for the large part, returned with interest.

In a way, Joint, a shy, self-effacing figure who jokingly refers to herself as the "Ginger Ninja", looked the perfect opponent for Williams, a rising star suffering a difficult 'second-season' slump who looked as if she might fold under pressure.

The opposite proved true, though. Yes, Joint did succumb at the end of the second stanza, but she only responded even more fiercely in the decider when the 23-time grand slam champion earned a break for 2-1, moving into her first lead in the final set.

Joint took the next four games as the physical toll began to tell on the mother-of-two, and there was even the sign of a limp at the end of her first singles...

title.en: Police hunt for Monaco bomb suspect after Ukrainian tycoon wounded
title.zh: 乌克兰大亨受伤后警方追捕摩纳哥炸弹嫌疑人

summary.en: Home to some of the world's wealthiest people, the incident has rocked the ultra-safe principality.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Police on Wednesday were searching for the suspect behind a parcel bomb that seriously wounded a sanctioned multi-millionaire of Ukrainian origin and two others in Monaco, after the unprecedented attack rocked the super-safe principality.

Officers in Monaco and neighbouring France were hunting for a man in a black fisherman's hat who appeared in surveillance footage after leaving a package in a residential building near the border, authorities said.

The device exploded at around 9 pm on Monday (5 am Tuesday AEST), leaving a man and a woman seriously wounded and a 13-year-old with lighter injuries, according to the Monegasque authorities.

Monaco public prosecutor Stephane Thibault said as of Tuesday the man had been stabilised, but the woman's condition remained "life-threatening".

He said the blast was being investigated as "attempted murder" but was not being considered as a "terrorist" act.

He declined to say who was the presumed target of the blast, but several sources have said it was Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolaiev, who is a permanent resident of Monaco and has acquired Cypriot nationality.

Yermolaiev is a sanctioned multi-millionaire with a reportedly long list of enemies in his homeland.

Kyiv alleges the 58-year-old maintained an alcohol business in Russia-annexed Crimea — paying taxes to Moscow even after it invaded Ukraine in 2022.

A source told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency that people would have been lining up to gun the construction magnate down in Dnipro, the industrial Ukrainian city where he made his wealth.

Monaco's Minister of State Christophe Mirmand said he was not aware of any specific threats against Yermolaiev.

"The family's behaviour before entering their block of flats did not appear to show any signs of concern on their part," he told broadcaster BFMTV.

"They were dressed for summer, relaxed and did not appear to be taking any particular precautions," he added.

The wounded had been taken to hospital in the southern French city of Nice. A source close to the case had said the man had suffered severe burns and the woman was in critical condition.

John Bulanadi, a 19-year-old student living near the site of the incident, told AFPTV he had heard a loud explosion.

"I quickly went out onto my terrace to see what was happening. There was screaming, crying and two people on the ground," he said.

Monaco's Prince Albert II described the incident as a "heinous crime" and "a shock to the entire Monegasque community".

title.en: China's tech rise reshapes the global space race
title.zh: 中国科技崛起重塑全球太空竞赛

summary.en: China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

Lai Kai-ying, the first female Chinese civilian to reach outer space, is currently on board China's crewed Tiangong space station , where she orbits the Earth 16 times a day, alongside two other Chinese astronauts.

Tiangong is a unique microgravity laboratory for scientific experiments, designed to provide new insights into humanity's future.

Today, aviation and spaceflight are once again shaped by ideological rivalry, echoing the mid-20th-century space race between the United States and the Soviet Union. In the 21st century, however, Washington's primary competitor is no longer Moscow, but Beijing.

US space agency NASA intends to retire its landmark research outpost, the International Space Station (ISS), by 2032. When that happens, China will be the only country operating a permanently crewed orbital station.

Space travel is just one of many fields worldwide in which China now holds a technological lead, according to Nature.

The journal's latest index of research leaders , which reveals the leading institutions and countries/territories, puts China in first place — well ahead of the United States and Germany . 

Nine of the Top 10 research institutions were from China, with the US' Harvard ranking third. Germany's Max Planck Society (MPG), Germany's preeminent research organization, ranked in 13th place.

"It is now almost irrelevant which global rankings you consult. Universities and research institutions in China lead in many fields," observed Christina Beck, spokesperson for theMPG.

The Nature Index also shows that Chinese research institutions are the clear leaders in biology, chemistry and physics, as well as in other applied sciences. Only in health sciences and the social sciences have they been surpassed by US institutions.

China's rise has taken place steadily over the past two decades, said Richard Heidler, director of information management at the German Research Foundation (DFG), Germany's largest research funding organization.

"While in the early 2000s it was primarily the volume of publications that increased significantly, bibliometric analyses over the past decade have also shown growing gains in impact-related indicators, such as the share and number of highly cited publications," Heidler said.

In other words, China is not only publishing more, but is becoming increasingly better and more visible, which the MPG's Beck said is based on a long-term development process.

body.zh: 中国在全球研究排名中处于领先地位，并扩大了其在太空领域的雄心。随着技术领先地位的不断增强，北京正在将自己定位为美国在全球范围内的竞争对手。 赖凯英是第一位到达外太空的中国女性平民，目前正在中国载人天宫空间站上，与另外两名中国宇航员一起每天绕地球运行 16 圈。 天宫是一个独特的微重力科学实验实验室，旨在为人类的未来提供新的见解。 如今，航空和航天再次受到意识形态竞争的影响，与20世纪中叶美国和苏联之间的太空竞赛相呼应。然而，进入21世纪，华盛顿的主要竞争对手不再是莫斯科，而是北京。 美国航天局 (NASA) 计划在 2032 年之前退役其具有里程碑意义的研究前哨站——国际空间站 (ISS)。届时，中国将成为唯一运营永久载人轨道站的国家。 据《自然》杂志报道，太空旅行只是中国目前在全球拥有技术领先地位的众多领域之一。 该杂志最新的研究领袖指数揭示了领先的机构和国家/地区，其中中国位居榜首，远远领先于美国和德国。 排名前十的研究机构中有九家来自中国，美国哈佛大学排名第三。德国杰出的研究组织德国马克斯·普朗克学会 (MPG) 排名第 13 位。 “现在你参考哪个全球排名几乎已经无关紧要了。中国的大学和研究机构在许多领域都处于领先地位，”MPG 发言人克里斯蒂娜·贝克 (Christina Beck) 表示。 自然指数还显示，中国研究机构在生物学、化学和物理学以及其他应用科学领域处于明显领先地位。只有在健康科学和社会科学领域被美国机构超越。 德国最大的研究资助机构德国研究基金会（DFG）信息管理部主任理查德·海德勒表示，中国在过去二十年中稳步崛起。 海德勒说：“虽然在 2000 年代初期，主要是出版物数量显着增加，但过去十年的文献计量分析也显示，与影响力相关的指标不断增长，例如高被引出版物的份额和数量。” 换句话说，中国不仅出版得更多，而且变得越来越好、越来越引人注目，MPG的贝克表示，这是基于长期发展过程的。 “其中的关键是多年来对中国科研机构和大学持续、系统的资助——......

title.en: A plane crashed into a tower in Beijing but China is not saying what happened
title.zh: 一架飞机在北京撞上大楼，但中国未说明情况

summary.en: A plane reportedly crashed into a tower in Beijing, leaving visible damage. However, authorities have removed other traces of the incident and have not provided an explanation.
summary.zh: 据报道，一架飞机在北京撞上了一座大楼，造成了明显的损坏。然而，当局已经清除了事件的其他痕迹，并且没有提供任何解释。

body.en:
It has been four days since a small plane slammed into Beijing's tallest skyscraper , killing the pilot – the only person on board – and wounding 13 others, but it's still unclear why, and how, that happened.

A 60-word report detailing the basic facts in state-owned Beijing Daily is the only official statement China has published so far on the crash, which happened just a few kilometres from Zhongnanhai, the Communist Party's headquarters.

Friday's collision left holes on the side of the 109-storey CITIC Tower, which have since been boarded up. Dramatic footage of the incident has been scrubbed off the internet. At least three aviation firms tell the BBC they've been told to suspend light aircraft operations but declined to elaborate, saying they had been instructed not to discuss it.

Amid the information vacuum, speculation is mounting as to how the aircraft managed to penetrate a city which has some of the world's strictest airspace controls.

China is no stranger to censorship. Criticism of the party, the country's leaders or the government is rare, and any discussions that seem critical, have political implications or touch upon sensitive issues quickly disappear.

But this time it has gone well beyond the obvious targets. Photographs and memes of the skyscraper, which are unrelated to Friday's incident, have also been removed from Chinese social media platforms.

Shaped like a Chinese wine vessel, the building is a local crowd-puller. Many see it as a lucky charm and young people wishing for good fortune, from exam results to jobs, either stop by or share photos of it online, along with a quick prayer.

The censorship machinery kicked in so quickly and thoroughly this time possibly because Beijing's leadership is "still not exactly sure what happened", says Manya Koetse, who runs the Eye on Digital China newsletter.

"This is a highly unusual incident," she says, adding that it calls into question government competence and threatens "important party narratives".

Even those aviation firms that confirmed to the BBC that authorities have grounded light aircraft operations since the incident did not wish to say more.

"We were told to not speak about it. Please ask others," said a lady at a flight training institute in Beijing.

Another firm in Chengdu declined to specify which authority the instruction came from, and promptly ended the call.

Beijing enforces a permanent no-fly zone of roughly 100 sq km (39 sq miles) over its political core covering Tiananmen Square and Zhongnanhai, the heavily guarded compound where the country's top leaders live and work .

In their first joint statement in seven years, the two sides agreed in Brussels to open a formal trade consultation after weeks of threats and recriminations from China if the EU imposed any measures to stop the flood of goods and components into the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 经过数周的威胁，双方同意努力使双边关系“更加平衡” 欧盟和中国同意进行为期三个月的谈判，以避免因欧盟每年 3600 亿欧元（3100 亿英镑）的进出口失衡而爆发贸易战。在七年来的首份联合声明中，双方同意在布鲁塞尔举行正式贸易磋商，此前中国连续数周发出威胁和指责，如果欧盟采取任何措施阻止商品和零部件大量涌入欧盟，两国将启动正式贸易磋商。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world often quick to escalate disputes, the agreement between the EU and China to engage in talks to resolve trade imbalances offers a hopeful example of pursuing peace. Yahweh's word encourages us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, seeking common ground even amidst significant disagreements. This diplomatic effort reflects a...
reflection.zh: 在一个常常迅速升级争端的世界里，欧盟与中国同意通过谈判解决贸易不平衡问题，提供了一个追求和平的充满希望的范例。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要我们能做到，就尽力与所有人和平相处，即使在重大分歧中也要寻求共同点。这种外交努力体现了对话而非冲突的承诺，通过耐心的谈判争取建立平衡的关系。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heatwave expected to bring Germany and Poland to 40C
title.zh: 天气追踪：德国和波兰预计将迎来40摄氏度高温热浪

summary.en: An intense heatwave is expected to bring temperatures up to 40C in parts of central and northern Europe, including Germany and Poland. The Austrian Grand Prix has declared a heat hazard due to the dramatic rise in temperatures.
summary.zh: 预计一股强烈的热浪将使中欧和北欧部分地区（包括德国和波兰）的气温升至40摄氏度。由于气温急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛已宣布高温危险。

body.en: Austrian Grand Prix declares heat hazard as dramatic rise in temperatures forecast in central and northern Europe Temperatures are forecast to rise dramatically in parts of central and northern Europe this weekend as the intense heatwave continues . In Germany and Poland, highs up to or exceeding 40C (104F) are expected on both Saturday and Sunday, days after swathes of France experienced similar extreme temperatures. The Austrian Grand Prix, taking place this weekend in Spielberg, has declared a heat hazard , the first race to do so this season. Temperatures are expected to rise into the low 30s celsius during the race, almost 10C warmer than usual for the venue. Across Europe, the intense heat has led to severe thunderstorms. In the Sverdlovsk region of central Russia, a strong tornado was reported on the evening of 22 June. Rated a 3 out of 5 on the international Fujita scale, the twister injured 16 people and destroyed or damaged about 100 homes and businesses in the town of Kushva. Emergency services have been working on restoring power to the town. Tornadoes are not unheard of in Russia but are rare. Forecasters say they may become more common in future as the climate breaks down. Storm warnings remained in effect in the southern part of the country on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预计中欧和北欧气温将急剧上升，奥地利大奖赛宣布存在热危险 随着强烈热浪的持续，预计本周末中欧和北欧部分地区气温将大幅上升。在德国和波兰，预计周六和周日气温将达到或超过 40 摄氏度（104 华氏度），几天前法国大片地区也经历了类似的极端气温。本周末在斯皮尔伯格举行的奥地利大奖赛已宣布出现高温危险，这是本赛季第一场这样做的比赛。预计比赛期间气温将升至 30 摄氏度，比平时高出近 10 摄氏度。在整个欧洲，酷热导致了严重的雷暴天气。 6月22日晚，俄罗斯中部斯维尔德洛夫斯克地区报告出现强烈龙卷风。国际藤田等级评定为 3 级（满分 5 级），龙卷风造成 16 人受伤，并摧毁或损坏了库什瓦镇约 100 所房屋和企业。紧急服务部门一直致力于恢复该镇的供电。龙卷风在俄罗斯并非闻所未闻，但很罕见。预报员表示，随着气候的恶化，它们未来可能会变得更加普遍。周五，该国南部地区的风暴警告仍然有效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic rise in temperatures across Europe reminds us that creation itself is experiencing distress. As the natural world groans under changing conditions, we are called to reflect on our interconnectedness with the earth and its well-being. This intense heatwave serves as a poignant reminder of the broader challenges facing our shared home.
reflection.zh: 欧洲气温的急剧上升提醒我们，受造界本身正在经历痛苦。当自然界在不断变化的环境下发出呻吟时，我们被呼召反思我们与地球及其福祉的相互关联。这场强烈热浪是对我们共同家园所面临的更广泛挑战的深刻提醒。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Xi Jinping has hosted more than a dozen leaders this year, as ‘middle powers’ look beyond the US
title.zh: 习近平今年接待了十几位领导人，‘中间力量’超越美国寻求合作

summary.en: China's leader, Xi Jinping, has hosted numerous world leaders this year, aiming to promote an alternative global order. This effort is reportedly aided by the perceived unpredictability of the United States, prompting 'middle powers' to explore new international alignments.
summary.zh: 中国领导人习近平今年接待了多位世界各国领导人，旨在推动一种替代性的全球秩序。据报道，美国的反复无常助长了这一努力，促使“中等强国”寻求新的国际结盟。

body.en: China’s leader wants to promote his alternative to the current world order, and his efforts are being assisted by a capricious US Xi Jinping meets Bangladesh’s new prime minister on Friday, the latest in a wave of world leaders to visit Beijing this year as the Chinese leader builds his influence and economic ties, and seeks to “shift the balance of power” away from the west. Xi’s meeting with Tarique Rahman comes less than two weeks after the Chinese leader welcomed Myanmar’s military chief-turned-president, Min Aung Hlaing, in Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国领导人希望推行他对当前世界秩序的替代方案，他的努力得到了反复无常的美国的协助。习近平周五会见了孟加拉国新总理，这是今年访问北京的一波世界领导人中最新的一位，中国领导人正在建立影响力和经济联系，并寻求“改变力量平衡”，远离西方。习近平与塔里克·拉赫曼的会面是在中国领导人在北京欢迎缅甸军方最高领导人、现任总统敏昂莱之后不到两周。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights how nations are drawn to leaders who articulate a clear vision for the future, especially when existing global structures seem uncertain. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people and nations can lose their way. This underscores the profound impact of leadership that offers a coherent path forward.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调，当现有的全球秩序显得不确定时，各国会被那些为未来描绘清晰愿景的领导人所吸引。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有指引的异象，人民和国家就会迷失方向。这突显了提供连贯前进道路的领导力所产生的深远影响。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: UK to halve tariff-free steel imports to counter glut of cheap Chinese metal
title.zh: 英国将削减免关税钢材进口量以应对廉价中国金属过剩

summary.en: The UK government announced it will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports, doubling duties on quantities exceeding the new quota. This measure, mirrored by similar changes in EU limits, aims to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and support domestic industry.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布将把免关税钢材进口量减半，超出新配额的进口将加倍征收关税。此举与欧盟的类似调整相呼应，旨在应对全球廉价中国金属的过剩供应，并扶持本国产业。

body.en: Duty on imports outside new quota will double in move echoing similar changes in EU limits Business live – latest updates The UK government will halve the amount of tariff-free steel imports allowed in an attempt to counter a global oversupply of cheap Chinese metal and bolster its beleaguered local industry. New “safeguards” will be introduced on 1 July and will coincide with similar new limits being introduced by the EU for the same purposes. The UK said it and the EU had agreed an approach that reflected each other’s “highly interconnected supply chains” after months of negotiations over retaining tariff-free access between the markets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新配额之外的进口关税将翻倍，与欧盟限制的类似变化相呼应英国政府将允许的免关税钢铁进口量减半，以应对全球廉价中国金属供应过剩的问题，并提振陷入困境的当地工业。新的“保障措施”将于 7 月 1 日推出，并将与欧盟出于相同目的推出的类似新限制同时实施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nations often grapple with balancing economic interests and ensuring fair trade practices. Proverbs 11:1 reminds us that Yahweh values honest dealings and just measures in commerce. This principle encourages leaders to seek equitable solutions that promote integrity in global markets.
reflection.zh: 国家常在经济利益与确保公平贸易实践之间寻求平衡。箴言11:1提醒我们，雅伟看重商业中的诚实交易和公正的度量。这一原则鼓励领导者寻求公平的解决方案，以促进全球市场的诚信。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: What is China’s SpaceSail, and could it rival Elon Musk’s Starlink?
title.zh: 中国的“太空帆”是什么？它能与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争吗？

summary.en: China's state-backed SpaceSail project is developing a satellite internet constellation to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. With hundreds of satellites in low Earth orbit, the company is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries.
summary.zh: 中国国家支持的“太空帆”项目正在开发一个卫星互联网星座，旨在与埃隆·马斯克的星链竞争。该公司目前在近地轨道拥有数百颗卫星，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判。

body.en: The company has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit but has state backing and is already reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries Elon Musk’s Starlink has long dominated the satellite internet industry, but a Chinese government-backed project is aiming to challenge its position. SpaceSail has just a few hundred satellites in low Earth orbit compared with Starlink’s 10,000-plus. But the company says it now has enough satellites to begin its first commercial application, is scaling up at speed, and is reportedly negotiating with dozens of countries to provide satellite internet coverage. Continue reading...
body.zh: 该公司在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星，但有国家支持，据报道已经与数十个国家进行谈判。埃隆·马斯克的星链长期以来一直主导着卫星互联网行业，但一个中国政府支持的项目旨在挑战其地位。与 Starlink 的 10,000 多颗卫星相比，SpaceSail 在近地轨道上只有几百颗卫星。但该公司表示，它现在拥有足够的卫星来开始其首次商业应用，并且正在快速扩大规模，据报道正在与数十个国家进行谈判以提供卫星互联网覆盖。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations and companies embark on ambitious technological ventures like SpaceSail, it reminds us of the human drive to innovate and connect the world. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our efforts, when aligned with His purposes, will find success. This perspective can guide us in all our endeavors, from grand...
reflection.zh: 当各国和公司着手像“太空帆”这样雄心勃勃的技术项目时，这提醒我们人类创新和连接世界的动力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将我们的计划交托给雅伟，相信我们的努力，若与祂的旨意相符，必将成功。这种视角可以指导我们所有的努力，无论是宏伟的项目还是日常任务。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Dear You review – enjoyable Chinese romdram crosses generations as it tracks down a missing husband
title.zh: 《亲爱的你》影评：一部跨越世代、追寻失踪丈夫的感人华语爱情剧情片

summary.en: The Guardian China reviews "Dear You," a Chinese romantic drama by director Lan Hongchun. The film is a multi-generational family saga, spanning from the 1940s to the present, primarily set in Bangkok, and follows the search for a husband who disappeared in Thailand.
summary.zh: 《卫报中国》评论了导演蓝鸿春的华语爱情剧情片《亲爱的你》。这部电影是一部跨越几代人的家族传奇，故事从20世纪40年代至今，主要背景设在曼谷，讲述了一个家庭寻找在泰国失踪的丈夫的故事。

body.en: Director Lan Hongchun’s family saga feels like a good old-fashioned novel as it goes in search of a man who has disappeared in Thailand With a story that ranges from the 1940s to the present and, although mostly set in Bangkok, revolving largely around Teochew-speaking Chinese from Guangdong, this generations-spanning drama feels like a good old-fashioned novel. A romantic beach read, perhaps, the kind in which coincidences and random accidents cause misunderstandings that last for decades until the truth is finally revealed. It’s sentimental in places, sure, but there’s also a fair bit of salty, bawdy humour to cut the sweetness, lashings of period colour, and impressively naturalistic performances from a mostly non-professional cast. All that has helped to make this an unexpectedly large box-office hit in the People’s Republic last month; and for non-Chinese or Thai rom-dram aficionados anywhere, it’s well worth looking out for. As the story opens in the 21st century in the Chinese city of Shantou, octogenarian Shurou (Iap Sok-jiu) is celebrating her 87th birthday, surrounded by adoring friends, family and neighbours who revere the matriarch, not least for managing to raise three kids on her own in the 1940s and 50s. Her shifty grandson Xiaowei (Hiau-ui), however, is less of a solid citizen and, having got into debt, he decides to travel to Bangkok to find out if Shurou’s husband Zheng Musheng, not seen for decades, could help out since he’s reputed to have made a fortune out there, endowed schools all over Thailand, and had a second family after abandoning Shurou. Continue reading...
body.zh: 导演兰鸿春的家庭传奇感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说，讲述了在泰国寻找失踪男子的故事。故事范围从 20 世纪 40 年代至今，虽然主要以曼谷为背景，但主要围绕来自广东的潮州华人展开，这部跨越几代人的戏剧感觉就像一部优秀的老式小说。浪漫的海滩读物，也许是那种巧合和偶然的事故会导致持续数十年的误会，直到真相最终揭晓的类型。当然，它在某些地方是感伤的，但也有一些咸味、下流的幽默来削弱甜蜜，充满时代色彩，以及来自大多数非专业演员的令人印象深刻的自然主义表演。所有这些都使得该片上个月在中华人民共和国取得了意想不到的票房大成功。对于任何地方的非中国或泰国的浪漫剧爱好者来说，这都非常值得一看。故事发生在 21 世纪的中国汕头市，八十多岁的淑柔（叶淑如饰）正在庆祝她的 87 岁生日，周围都是崇拜这位女族长的朋友、家人和邻居，尤其是她在 20 世纪 40 年代和 50 年代设法独自抚养三个孩子。然而，她狡猾的孙子小伟（孝仪饰）却不是一个踏实的公民，负债累累，他决定前往曼谷，看看书柔数十年未见的丈夫郑木胜是否可以帮忙，因为他在外面发了大财，为泰国各地的学校捐款，并在抛弃书柔后有了第二个家庭。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The multi-generational search for a missing husband in "Dear You" powerfully illustrates the enduring nature of family bonds. This long quest reflects the deep commitment inherent in marriage, where two become one, a union that transcends time and distance. It reminds us that true connection often calls for steadfastness, even in the face of profound...
reflection.zh: 电影《亲爱的你》中跨越几代人寻找失踪丈夫的故事，有力地展现了家庭纽带的持久性。这场漫长的寻觅反映了婚姻中固有的深刻承诺，夫妻二人成为一体，这种结合超越了时间和距离。它提醒我们，真正的连接往往需要坚韧不拔，即使面对巨大的不确定性也是如此。

verse.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verse.textZh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。

title.en: Australia Desk
title.zh: 澳洲栏目

strap.en: Public life, policy, and community stories shaping Australia now.
strap.zh: 关注正在影响澳洲公共生活、政策与社区的新闻。

title.en: Josh Burns says partner Georgie Purcell faces antisemitic abuse because she is Jewish, commission hears
title.zh: 乔什·伯恩斯称其伴侣乔治·珀塞尔因犹太身份面临反犹太虐待，委员会听证会获悉

summary.en: A royal commission investigating antisemitism and social cohesion heard testimony about individuals, including Georgie Purcell, facing vile and threatening antisemitic abuse, often amplified by misogyny. Witnesses described being subjected to hate speech during the proceedings.
summary.zh: 调查反犹太主义和社会凝聚力的皇家委员会听取了证词，内容涉及包括乔治·珀塞尔在内的个人，因其犹太身份而面临恶毒和威胁性的反犹太虐待，这种虐待常因厌女症而加剧。证人描述了在听证会期间遭受仇恨言论的经历。

body.en: The royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion hears how witnesses are subjected to hate speech amplified by misogyny Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Vile, threatening abuse is being levelled at witnesses to the antisemitism royal commission, the inquiry has heard, while a Labor MP has said attacks on his partner were heightened because they were stacked with misogyny. Meanwhile, data analysis has shown how quickly factual reports are transformed into conspiracy theories online, and that while there was a spike in antisemitism after the Bondi terror attack, there was a “huge spike” in anti-Muslim hate. Continue reading...
body.zh: 反犹太主义和社会凝聚力皇家委员会听取了证人如何遭受厌女症放大的仇恨言论的影响。调查获悉，反犹太主义皇家委员会的证人正在受到威胁性虐待，而一名工党议员表示，针对他的伴侣的攻击因充斥着厌女症而加剧。与此同时，数据分析显示，事实报道在网上转变为阴谋论的速度有多快，虽然邦迪恐怖袭击后反犹太主义激增，但反穆斯林仇恨也“大幅飙升”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The report of vile and threatening abuse highlights how reckless words can deeply wound and cause significant harm, much like sword thrusts. In a world where hate speech is amplified, Yahweh calls us to speak with wisdom and grace, seeking to bring healing rather than further division.
reflection.zh: 有关恶毒和威胁性虐待的报道凸显了鲁莽的言语如何像刀剑刺入般深深伤害他人。在一个仇恨言论被放大的世界里，雅伟呼召我们以智慧和恩典说话，寻求带来医治而非进一步的分裂。

verse.textEn: The words of the reckless pierce like swords, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.
verse.textZh: 说话浮躁的，如刀刺人；智慧人的舌头却为医人的良药。

title.en: What does the arrival of bird flu in Australia mean for poultry and will eggs be more expensive?
title.zh: 禽流感登陆澳大利亚对家禽意味着什么？鸡蛋会更贵吗？

summary.en: In the event of an H5 outbreak, farms would have to close for several months, with producers having to source new chickens and grow them to size Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast An outbreak of the highly virulent bird flu strain H5N1 in commercial...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: In the event of an H5 outbreak, farms would have to close for several months, with producers having to source new chickens and grow them to size Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An outbreak of the highly virulent bird flu strain H5N1 in commercial poultry flocks could push egg prices over $10 a carton, business groups have warned. So far, there is no evidence that H5N1 bird flu has spread to poultry in Australia, following the first confirmed cases in wild birds across two states. Continue reading...
body.zh: 如果爆发 H5 禽流感，农场将不得不关闭几个月，生产者必须采购新鸡并将其饲养到一定尺寸。商业团体警告称，商业家禽群中爆发高毒力禽流感病毒 H5N1 可能会使每箱鸡蛋价格超过 10 美元。继澳大利亚两个州出现首例野生鸟类确诊病例后，迄今为止，尚无证据表明 H5N1 禽流感已传播至澳大利亚家禽。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

title.en: Revealed: The data behind Australia's 'great Socceroos sickie'
title.zh: 揭晓：澳大利亚“伟大的足球运动员”背后的数据

summary.en: Socceroos fans told SBS News they planned to "chuck a sickie". New data reveals just how many no-shows there were.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The Socceroos' World Cup lunchtime clash against Paraguay last Friday saw a spike in workplace no-shows, new data reveals, likely driven in part by a surge in staff calling in sick.

Rostering data provided to SBS News by workforce management software company Deputy showed absenteeism rose across the hospitality, retail, and services sectors.

The data tracked rostered shifts that went unworked and did not differentiate between those who called in sick, took annual leave or were no-shows.

But the increase in absenteeism, also seen during Australia's earlier World Cup fixtures, corresponded with the Socceroos' matches, suggesting at least some were calling in sick.

Socceroos supporter group Active Support dubbed the Paraguay match the "great Australian Socceroos sickie" as a "mysterious case of football fever" swept across the nation, and some fans told SBS News they planned to "chuck a sickie".

Gyms recorded the largest increase, with 37.4 per cent of shifts going unworked — up 14.7 percentage points compared with the average across the four Fridays from 29 May to 19 June.

"With a midday kickoff, the morning and lunchtime crews gyms lean on; front desks, group-fitness instructors and personal trainers appear to have been first out the door," Deputy said.

Security services recorded the next-biggest increase, with 12.9 per cent of shifts going unworked (up 7.1 percentage points), followed by pharmacies at 22.4 per cent (up 6.4 percentage points).

Deputy's chief technology officer Ciaran Hale said absenteeism among shift workers increased across almost every front line industry each time Australia played.

"The Paraguay match was particularly interesting because a lunchtime kickoff dropped right into the middle of the working day, and that had a ripple effect across sectors that keep communities running," he said.

Security services recorded the largest proportional jump, more than doubling normal absence levels, Hale said.

"Cafes, supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants and accommodation providers all experienced significant increases as well."

A similar pattern was seen in Australia's earlier group-stage matches against Türkiye and the United States.

For the Sunday afternoon match against Türkiye, security services recorded the highest absenteeism rate at 36.1 per cent of rostered shifts — up 15.3 percentage points from the average across the five Sundays between 10 May and 7 June.

Pharmacies followed at 30.3 per cent (up 15.3 percentage points), ahead of beauty services at 22.7 per cent (up 13.2 percentage points).

title.en: Australia's happiness divide has been revealed — and one worry stands out
title.zh: 澳大利亚的幸福鸿沟已经暴露——一个令人担忧的问题

summary.en: More than 15,000 Australians were asked about happiness, optimism and the nation’s biggest concerns. One issue dominated.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australians are anxious about money — and losing faith things will get better. 

That's according to a major new survey of more than 15,000 Australians which has found that cost of living pressure isn't just the nation's top worry — it's also bleeding into how hopeful people feel about the future.

The 2026 Wicked Problems Report from Flinders University found 65 per cent of Australians rank cost of living as their biggest concern, ahead of housing affordability (40 per cent), crime and safety (37 per cent) and healthcare access (26 per cent).

At the other end of the scale, education, social connection, and inequities facing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people ranked as the lowest national concerns — the latter finishing last overall.

For the first time, the survey also measured happiness and optimism nationally — and the gap between the two is stark.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While 69 per cent of Australians say they're happy, far fewer are confident things are heading in the right direction, with many states recording optimism levels barely above a third of respondents.

Almost three-quarters (76 per cent) of those who said they were unhappy pointed to the same root cause: the cost of living.

Cost pressures were found to be hitting working-age households hardest — particularly gen X and gen Y — who are more likely to be balancing mortgages and rent alongside the rising cost of raising a family.

Younger Australians — nearly half (45 per cent) of gen Z and gen Y — were concerned about housing affordability, compared with a third of baby boomers, who are instead more worried about healthcare as they age.

The divide shows up geographically too. Housing pressure is more acute in Western Australia, South Australia and NSW. Crime and safety dominates concern in the Northern Territory, and is a fast-rising worry in Victoria.

Victorians recorded the lowest happiness of any state or territory — 65.9 per cent, against a national average of 69 per cent.

It also saw one of the lowest optimism scores (26.3 per cent), alongside Tasmania (23.7 per cent) and NT (23.3 per cent), and reported rising concern about crime and safety.

Western Australia saw the opposite. It recorded the second-highest happiness in the country (70.6 per cent) and, by a clear margin, the highest optimism (47 per cent).

The NT and ACT post even stronger happiness numbers (75.3 per cent and 74 per cent respectively), but neither backed it up with strong optimism — showing that how people feel right now and how hopeful they are about the future don't always move together.

title.en: 'She has such an aura': The 20-year-old Aussie who just beat Serena Williams at Wimbledon
title.zh: “她有这样的光环”：刚刚在温网击败塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的 20 岁澳大利亚人

summary.en: Rising Australian tennis star Maya Joint produced the best match of her career to prevail over the tennis legend.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Serena Williams' Wimbledon comeback at 44 has been sensationally dynamited on Centre Court by Australian Maya Joint, who delivered a stunning performance to out-battle and finally subdue the hugely impressive returning legend.

In the match of her life, the 20-year-old Queenslander produced the best display of her career to prevail 6-3 6-7 (6-8) 6-3, withstanding everything that the player who may be the game's greatest ever could throw at her.

Joint overcame the disappointment of missing out on a match point when on the verge of a straight-sets win, then battled back after Williams had roared into a third-set lead to seal a monumental triumph in a two-hour 22-minute classic.

The emotional victory left Joint, who grew up in the US state of Michigan where Williams was also born, almost dumbfounded.

"I didn't get much sleep last night, I was up 'til 2 am just thinking about it. She has such an aura, she's such a legend," she told the crowd.

"I've been dreaming about this moment since I was a little kid, so this is pretty crazy."

Williams left her old Centre Court domain as she'd entered it, to thunderous cheers from the crowd, and she offered a wave to all sides, which had a real valedictory feel.

For though she may have been more than half-a-step slower and inevitably rusty after nearly four years away from singles action, she was still astonishingly impressive, three months before her 45th birthday against one of the sport's rising stars.

Yet her US-born opponent stayed strong, even as seemingly all the crowd were baying for a sentimental Serena triumph under the roof, perhaps proving how much the game has moved on in the 23-time slam champion's absence.

Joint had lost 13 of her previous 14 matches stretching back to January and had dropped to No.87 to be only the Australian No.4, but she was still a cut above the old champion, who threw in 190km/h-plus serves and occasional rocket groundstrokes, only to have them, for the large part, returned with interest.

In a way, Joint, a shy, self-effacing figure who jokingly refers to herself as the "Ginger Ninja", looked the perfect opponent for Williams, a rising star suffering a difficult 'second-season' slump who looked as if she might fold under pressure.

The opposite proved true, though. Yes, Joint did succumb at the end of the second stanza, but she only responded even more fiercely in the decider when the 23-time grand slam champion earned a break for 2-1, moving into her first lead in the final set.

title.en: Australia's supermarket price crackdown starts today. But will you pay less?
title.zh: 澳大利亚超市价格打击行动今日启动。但你会支付更少吗？

summary.en: New laws have been introduced in Australia to address concerns over excessive grocery prices. However, experts are cautious, suggesting that the actual impact on consumer costs at the checkout might be limited.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚开始实施新法律，旨在打击过高的食品杂货价格。但专家表示，这些法律对消费者结账时支付的价格影响可能有限。

body.en:
Australia's new anti-price gouging laws come into effect today, making it illegal for supermarkets with more than $30 billion in revenue to charge prices deemed significantly excessive compared with the cost of supply.

In practice, that means Coles and Woolworths — the only two supermarkets that meet the threshold — face fines of up to $10 million if found guilty of "significantly excessive" prices compared to the product's cost.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers previously said the changes would give Australians a "fairer go" at the checkout. But experts aren't so sure.

The new laws might prevent price gouging at Australia's two biggest supermarkets, but they might not change your tally at the checkout.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The new laws won't make grocery bills cheaper," Lisa Asher, retail expert at the University of Sydney Business School, told SBS News.

"It will prevent [groceries] from getting more expensive due to price gouging from Coles and Woolworths only. The issue is, I don't actually think they were."

In a report last year, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) found the near-duopoly of Coles and Woolworths gave them little incentive to compete vigorously , noting that they were among the most profitable supermarkets in the world.

But its report never directly accused the supermarkets of gouging customers, and it's something both Coles and Woolworths have denied.

Asher said rising grocery bills are more due to a structural lack of competition in the Australian market.

"Until there is meaningful competition in the Australian market which forces our retailers to actually compete for us, then we will continue to see higher prices," she said.

Experts say the laws will be difficult to enforce in practice and even harder to use to win back customers' trust.

"The law's real test won't be in court; it'll be in the public's gut. Shoppers don't compare prices to a retailer's costs, they compare them to what they remember paying last time," associate professor Meg Elkins, a behavioural economist at RMIT University, said.

"The law's test is cost-based, asking whether the price is excessive relative to the cost of supply. But the public's test is memory-based, asking whether this price is higher than expected.

"A retailer can clear the legal bar easily, for entirely legitimate reasons like a bad harvest or rising freight costs, and it will still feel like gouging at the checkout."

title.en: Pay less, owe it longer: What the HELP shake-up means for young Australians
title.zh: 还款减少，欠债更久：HELP政策调整对澳大利亚年轻人的影响

summary.en: New HELP rules mean smaller repayments now — but a longer debt later. We crunch the numbers on who really comes out ahead.
summary.zh: 新的HELP政策意味着现在还款额减少，但债务期限会更长。我们分析了谁将从中真正受益。

body.en:
Grace (surname withheld) was 18 when she took on a debt she didn't fully understand.

Drawn to a career in public policy, she enrolled in an Applied Public Health and Global Studies course. But the degree, which features science-heavy units — anatomy, physiology and laboratory work — cost far more than she anticipated.

"When I was at school, I was naive … I didn't realise it was a loan that you have to pay back."

Now 24 and working as an executive coordinator at a public hospital, the recent graduate has watched her loan balance swing in ways that feel beyond her control.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A one-off 20 per cent reduction to HELP (Higher Education Loan Program) debts and other student loans — a centrepiece of Labor's 2025 election pitch — stripped roughly $8,600 from her loan last year, taking it from about $43,000 to the low $30,000s.

But HELP debts are indexed to inflation annually on 1 June, and the most recent adjustment has already bumped her balance up again to around $35,000.

Grace has chosen not to make voluntary repayments, wary that any savings she contributes could simply be undone.

The average student loan in Australia sits at $27,640 and takes close to a decade — about 9.9 years — to clear in full.

With the onset of the new financial year, the benefit of a second, lesser-known reform is landing in the tax returns of Grace and roughly three million other Australians who still carry student debt.

The repayment threshold — the income at which repayments begin — has risen sharply from $54,000 to $67,000, and repayments are now levied only on earnings above that threshold, rather than as a percentage of a person's total income.

The result: most borrowers will repay less each year, and those earning under $67,000 will owe nothing at all until their income rises.

Only those earning $179,286 and above continue to repay at the same rate as before — 10 per cent of their total income.

Accountant Scott Kay of Integrity Plus Accounting, who prepared the financial analysis behind this story for The Feed, describes the reform as "clever modelling by the government to help lower earners keep more of their cash in their pocket".

For most borrowers — those earning between $67,000 and $179,286 — the headline change is less money withheld from their pay each fortnight.

Repayments apply only to the portion of income above $67,000, meaning those just above threshold benefit most. Previously, they paid a percentage of their entire income, rather than on the thin slice above the line.
